freeWills: ONE SOUL. TWO LIVES. TWO FREE WILLS.
introEyebrow: THE ENCOUNTER IS ONLY THE BEGINNING
introTitle: Some people change the way we see everything.
introParagraphs: A stranger feels familiar. A connection arrives at the wrong time. Someone touches a part of you that you thought you had lost.

{book} follows these moments into deeper questions about love, identity and the evolution of consciousness. It explores an unusual possibility: a soul meeting itself through two overlapping human lives.
At its heart is a very human invitation: to understand what an encounter awakens in you, honour another person’s freedom, and return to your own life.
insideIntro: From the mystery of connection to the freedom to live.
parts: The feeling of recognition. The tension between heart and mind. The encounters that leave us asking why.
An invitation to look beyond our everyday identity and ask who we are when the mind grows quiet.
A philosophical exploration of consciousness, continuity and the possibility of one soul encountering itself in two lives.
Loving without possession. Respecting another person’s choices. Beginning to live the life that is already yours.
modelEyebrow: A DIFFERENT WAY TO ASK THE QUESTION
modelParagraphs: The book introduces MIRIEC — the Model of Incarnational Recursive Interaction and Evolution of Consciousness — as a philosophical framework for exploring soul identity and human experience.
It considers the possibility that two people may share a deeper continuity of consciousness while remaining distinct individuals, each with their own body, mind and choices.
modelEmphasis: No connection takes away someone’s freedom. No spiritual label asks you to put your life on hold.
modelNote: MIRIEC is presented as a spiritual and philosophical exploration, rather than an established scientific theory.
quoteEyebrow: A THOUGHT TO TAKE WITH YOU
quote: Your life is not a waiting room for destiny. It is where destiny meets your decisions.
